## Appearance

Anne is a skinny, freckled girl with a pointed face and solemn gray eyes. She has a thin little body with ungracefully long legs, and her hair—which is often worn in long braids—is red, though she refers to it as auburn, and at one point it turned green. When excited, her unbraided hair streams behind her in a torrent of brightness, accompanied by shining eyes and faintly pink-flushed cheeks.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P0](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P12](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER VIII. ## Personality

Highly imaginative, talkative, and passionate, she possesses an intense personality marked by strong likes and dislikes, though she is also known to be heedless, impulsive, and forgetful when having fun or falling into daydreams. Her drive to succeed is evident in her ambition to become a teacher, her goal of passing high in examinations for Matthew's sake, and her hard work to win the Avery scholarship in order to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) in September. Alongside her talents in writing compositions, rowing a dory, singing, public recitation, and decorating with artistic taste, she has demonstrated remarkable skill and presence of mind in treating croup in young children. Despite her accomplishments, she admits to being vain about her long, thick, curly hair and harbors a fear of going through the [Haunted Wood](../codex/places.md#haunted-wood) after dark.

## History

Born in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), Anne Shirley was orphaned at a young age and lived with Mrs. [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) until she was eight, later spending over two years with Mrs. [Hammond](../character/hammond.md) and four months in an asylum at [Hopeton](../codex/places.md#hopeton). She was subsequently brought to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) ultimately decided to keep and raise her. Anne quickly formed a lifelong friendship with her neighbor, [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). However, her early days in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) were marked by temperamental outbursts, including a fiery rage at Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) over insults about her red hair, as well as an intense grudge against classmate [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) after he called her 'Carrots' at school. Her hot-headedness also led to a broken ankle when she accepted a dare from [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md) to walk a roof ridgepole. After accidentally dying her hair green with peddler-bought dye, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) had to cut it off completely. Later, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) rescued Anne when her boat sank during a theatrical game, but she spitefully rejected his offer of friendship. Encouraged by her teacher Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md), Anne joined the Queen's class to prepare for further education and ultimately tied for first place on the entrance examination. She attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) and set her sights on a scholarship, but when [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) died suddenly of a heart attack and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) faced losing her eyesight, Anne made the choice to give up her college scholarship to stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

## Quotes

> "Pretty well. I’m better at looking after children, though. I’ve had so much experience at that. It’s such a pity you haven’t any here for me to look after."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P24](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0024)

> “I think he’s lovely,” said Anne reproachfully. “He is so very sympathetic. He didn’t mind how much I talked—he seemed to like it. I felt that he was a kindred spirit as soon as ever I saw him.”
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026)

> "Oh, I don’t mean that sort of a name. I mean just a name you gave it yourself. Didn’t you give it a name? May I give it one then? May I call it—let me see—Bonny would do—may I call it Bonny while I’m here? Oh, do let me!"
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P33](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0033)

> "Pretty well. I imagine a good deal, and that helps to pass the time. Of course, it’s rather lonesome. But then, I may as well get used to that."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P11](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0011)

> "I don’t get cross about other things; but I’m so tired of being twitted about my hair and it just makes me boil right over. Do you suppose my hair will really be a handsome auburn when I grow up?"
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P43](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0043)

## Relationships

### [Allan](../character/allan.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/allan--anne-shirley.md)

Mr. Allan and his wife are good friends of Anne who visit [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for a tea party, where Anne accidentally flavors a layer cake with liniment instead of vanilla. Mrs. Allan kindly comforts a mortified Anne after the mishap and invites her to showcase her flower garden. Following Matthew's sudden death, Mrs. Allan continues to provide comfort to Anne as she processes her grief.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P29](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P31](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P35](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0035), +10 more_

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana-barry.md)

Anne and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) meet at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) and quickly pledge to be lifelong bosom friends and close companions. Their bond endures through school routines, dares, and separation, becoming fully restored after Anne helps nurse Diana's sister through severe croup. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) encourages Anne through various endeavors, including helping her dress for a concert recitation.

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--gilbert-blythe.md)

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--marilla-cuthbert.md)

[Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is Anne's guardian who brings her to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to raise and educate her. Though [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) initially intends to send Anne back due to an adoption mix-up, she decides to keep her, guiding her through religious instruction and daily upbringing while developing a deep affection for the girl over time.

### [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--matthew-cuthbert.md)

[Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) is Anne's guardian and one of her closest friends. ### [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--minnie-may.md)

Anne saves [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) by using her prior caretaking experience to nurse the young girl through a severe case of croup while her parents are away. This act earns the gratitude of the [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) family and restores Anne's broken friendship with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P35](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0035), +1 more_
